what: When the cursor moves over the panel, every 25ms an accent-color bar 5~100px wide is stood up centered on the cursor in the row it is in (panel height ÷ 3), then erased 2 seconds later. Overlaps in the same row are skipped, so bars pile up sparsely like a barcode. On touch devices a dot wandering inside the panel draws every 120ms. look: auto ignores the hand and every 150ms switches on a 10~150px bar in one of two rows, then turns it off over .5s after 2 seconds (over a portrait photo).

options.throttle: Minimum gap between cursor bars (ms), default 25
options.look: auto: Type that turns on and off on its own
